$comment: Working memory for music selection (see references/music-selection.md). Facts only: bpm/hook_start stay null until measured or checked on Instagram; lyric_safe is 'yes' only when the song's theme is well established, otherwise 'check' (ask the user). status: trending | evergreen | fading. Update 'verified' and 'feedback' after every trial.

songs.notes: Promo single. Film releases 2026-10-15 → expect reel peak through Oct–Nov.

songs.title: Bindaas
songs.notes: Upbeat party number (feat. Nora Fatehi). Party song: check lyrics before family/kids events.

songs.title: Singappenney
songs.notes: Women-in-sport anthem from a film about a women's football team. First pick for women's events/teams.

songs.title: Verithanam
songs.notes: Sung by Vijay; football-film mass number.

songs.title: Whistle Podu
songs.notes: Chennai Super Kings fan anthem: instant crowd recognition for cricket/box-cricket in Tamil Nadu. Several versions exist; confirm which one.

songs.title: Hukum – Thalaivar Alappara
songs.notes: Hero walk-out energy: tournament entries, captains, trophy lift. Jailer 2 release will revive it.

songs.title: Kaavaalaa
songs.notes: Massive dance-reel trend in 2023; risk of feeling overused, so prefer the Jailer 2 songs while they're fresh.

songs.title: Vaathi Coming
songs.notes: Signature dance hook; great for group dance moments.

songs.title: Arabic Kuthu
songs.notes: Kuthu dance anthem; very recognisable intro hook.

songs.title: Enjoy Enjaami
songs.notes: Joyful, rooted, community feel. Strong fit for wholesome community days.

songs.title: Megham Karukatha
songs.notes: Bright, relaxed, dance-able melody; long-running reel favourite.

songs.title: Mustafa Mustafa
songs.notes: The Tamil friendship anthem; nostalgic, every generation knows it. Friends' turf nights, farewells.

songs.title: Katchi Sera
songs.notes: Huge 2024 dance trend; may now read as last season's. Check before use.

songs.title: Naatu Naatu
songs.notes: Pan-South crossover (Oscar winner); explosive dance energy.

songs.title: Illuminati
songs.notes: Pan-South reel phenomenon; swagger energy for team intros.

rejected.reason: Trial 01: 'not good at all, the vibe is very bad'. Anonymous Western stock music doesn't land with a Tamil audience.
